== Description ==

[[Michael Riboulet]] and [[Philipp Jacobs]] at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Norfolk, December 1997.

== Source and credit ==

Jon Snyder, "1997 Star Wars Customizable Card Game World Championship", ''Star Wars Insider'' #37 (April 1998). Photographs by Jon Snyder. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials Star Wars Insider Magazines (1 to 153 + Specials)], Internet Archive ([https://archive.org/download/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials/Star%20Wars%20Insider%20037%20(1998).pdf Star Wars Insider 037 (1998).pdf]). Printed page 70 (PDF page 75). Caption: "2nd place winner Michael Riboulet (left) and World Champion Philipp Jacobs."
